title: Respect browser, account and staff consent in analytics collection

source.ref: Owner analytics dashboard and user-flow request, 2026-11-13.

detail: Production deployment dpl_4tJA2zajUgC3xgoUc2iVjx5kZYr9 for merged #4924 (main 2f1209773f76706f113bb38317e8ae6fa8494c9d) failed on 2026-11-14 at 02:21:09 UTC. The production alias continues serving 4e1e6aa; the build-specific failure cause requires Vercel logs and is not inferred. This safety rollback restores every application/source/test blob introduced or changed by #4924 to its exact 4e1e6aa version. The complete implementation remains preserved on codex/analytics-tracking. The frozen scripts/probes/analytics-tracking.mjs remains unchanged and now fails against the restored application, so this capability is honestly reopened. CI-only compiler provisioning and optional diagnostics remain to avoid the measured process-capacity OOM; no production artifact criterion, SQL, probe or independent test assertion was modified.
